verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's annual-report page lists the filings it handles: annual reports, initial reports, auto-filing, amendment filings and optional expedited filing. It also publishes up-front pricing: annual-report plans "start at $99" plus state fees, and registered agent service is $249/year with renewal terms disclosed. However, the evidence never says which states are covered, and the "starts at" price leaves the full cost and per-state fees unclear before purchase. Missing for 10: explicit list of supported states, per-state or per-tier full pricing including state fees, independent corroboration of pricing transparency.
